cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, random
rnd = random.Random(99)
C, E, W, K, F, S, L = 8, 4, 16, 5, 8, 256, 4
nconn = 100
model = {"classes": C, "embedding_dim": E,
  "length_embedding": [[rnd.choice([-128,127]) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
  "gap_embedding": [[rnd.choice([-128,127]) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
  "kernel": K,
  "conv_weights": [[[rnd.choice([-128,127]) for _ in range(2*E)] for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(F)],
  "conv_bias": [rnd.choice([-2147483648, 2147483647]) for _ in range(F)],
  "conv_shift": [16]*F,
  "dense_weights": [[rnd.choice([-128,127]) for _ in range(F)] for _ in range(C)],
  "dense_bias": [rnd.choice([-2147483648, 2147483647]) for _ in range(C)]}
config = {"slots": S, "window": W, "idle_timeout": 10**12, "len_quantum": 1,
  "gap_quantum": 1, "rate_num": 10**6, "rate_den": 1, "bucket_capacity": 512,
  "initial_tokens": 512, "pending_capacity": 512, "lanes": L, "service": [1]*C,
  "fallback": 7, "time_edges": list(range(16)), "count_edges": list(range(16)),
  "probability": [[65536]*16 for _ in range(16)]}
ids = ["Z"*32 if i==0 else ("id%030d" % i) for i in range(nconn)]
conns = [{"id": ids[i], "slot": i % S, "label": i % C, "split": "dev" if i%2 else "eval"} for i in range(nconn)]
pkts = []
t = 0
for i in range(20000):
    t += rnd.choice([1,2,3])
    pkts.append({"time": t, "connection": ids[i % nconn], "length": rnd.randint(0,65535), "draw": rnd.randint(0,65535)})
doc = {"version":1,"config":config,"model":model,"connections":conns,"packets":pkts}
s = json.dumps(doc)
open("/workspace/tmp/max.json","w").write(s)
print("input bytes", len(s))
PYEOF
ls -l tmp/max.json && time python3 submission/main.py < tmp/max.json > tmp/max.out && ls -l tmp/max.out && python3 -c "
import json,collections
d=json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/max.out'))
print('packets',len(d['packets']),'jobs',len(d['jobs']),'conns',len(d['connections']))
print(collections.Counter(p['decision'] for p in d['packets']))
print(collections.Counter(j['status'] for j in d['jobs']))
print(json.dumps(d['jobs'][0]))
" && python3 tmp/mem.py submission/main.py tmp/max.json
